system.description:
Genjutsu you cast don’t just affect the mind, they also leave behind effects on the real world. You gain the following benefits:

Genjutsu you cast that force Intelligence saves, can instead require a Strength save if you spend a Bonus action as part of its casting.

Genjutsu you cast that deal psychic damage to a creature forces them to take a d4 penalty to the next Strength or Dexterity saving throw they make.

Once per turn, when you deal psychic damage as a result of a Combat Scroll attack you make, the affected creature suffers a d4 penalty to their next attack roll, before the end of their next turn.

Evocation Ability – Psionic Payload. While wielding a Combat Scroll, when a creature under the effects of a Genjutsu you are concentrating on, makes an attack. You can roll a d6. On a roll of 1, they miss, regardless of their attack roll. Once they miss in this way, they cannot be affected by this stance again until you complete a rest.
system.requirement: Have a Genjutsu that forces a saving throw on your known list.
